projects.title: Shuttle Tracking System
projects.description: Senior Capstone project that creates a shuttle tracking system using geolocation services on mobile phones. The core idea is to use mobile devices as a tracking device in shuttles instead of a standard GPS tracking device. From there, Sean and I created a web client that has both front facing and driver facing views. On the driver's side, we use geolocation services to track the shuttle phone the driver is using, in order to display that location data onto our map. On the front facing end, we have an interactive map that riders can use to view shuttle locations, see current capacity in each shuttle, and also be able to view basic shuttle information. The project link will bring you to the CSI Capstone projects website where you will be able to view our final paper, 2 demos of our project, and also our project poster.

projects.description: This is the publication from the project that I worked on during my Technical Internship at the LCDI. In this publication, it describes what our goal was and how we achieved it.

organizations.name: Skyliners Drum and Bugle Corps
organizations.position: Member of the Color Guard · Apr 2016 - Sep 2017
organizations.description: I was a marching member of the Skyliners DBC for two seasons. We rehearsed every weekend starting around May and ending Labor Day weekend in September. We competed in DCA Open Class and won 11th both years I participated. From this activity, I learned a lot about teamwork, but also about individual responsibility and accountability.
